scientific_integrity: The theorem is analytically proved under stated finite-heavy/positive-diffuse assumptions. Finite checks are supplementary; originality is best-knowledge and not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: The residual diffuse mass must be strictly positive; the pure-atomic boundary is excluded.
Only finitely many weights may stay macroscopically positive, and sampling clocks have common rates.
Moving quorum thresholds, infinite heavy-weight families and rates not common across types are not classified.
A 2007 multiple-subset-collector paper was available only by abstract, so its full contents were not exhaustively compared.
No independent mathematical audit or conclusive historical-priority certification is claimed.
title: Mixed atomic–diffuse quorum clocks: exact limit laws and deterministic time atoms
